name: You.com
description: The You.com connector lets Claude access real-time web search and news results directly within your conversations. Use it to answer questions requiring current information, research topics with up-to-date sources, and get properly cited results from across the web. Key features include real-time search across news, web, and other verticals, source citations for fact-checking, and fast response times optimized for conversational use. Ideal for research, fact-checking, current events, and any task requiring information beyond Claude's training data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add You.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add You.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.you.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the You.com MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: You.com provides these MCP tools: you-answer, you-balance, you-contents, you-discover, you-research, and you-search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to You.com?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to You.com in search-research on the Manufact MCP catalog include Agentic Atlas: Agent Design Patterns, common-practice, GDELT Cloud, BookDNA, and Lyon.
You.com requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
You.com is developed by You.com. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
